newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end with slight gains.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end with slight gains.

text.p: Swiss shares ended a mixed session on Monday with slight gains thanks to stronger pharmaceutical shares, but volume was thin and trading uninspired, dealers said.
They said trading was mostly limited to professionals, with a holiday in the U.S. and the U.S. jobs data due next Friday dampening incentive to buy.
A firmer dollar also lended support in late trading, they said.
The Swiss Market Index (SMI) index of leading shares gained 8.4 points to 3,654.7, and the all-share Swiss Performance Index (SPI) rose 3.38 points to 2,346.37.

Novartis shares Ciba and Sandoz rose strongly with Ciba registered shares up 25 Swiss francs at 1,540. Sandoz registered added 18 francs to end at 1,446. Dealers said positive press reports supported both shares.
Roche certificates, up five at 9,150 francs, led the actives list.
